FUNCTION FindPairsWithSum(arr, target):
    seen <- EMPTY SET
    pairs <- EMPTY SET
    
    FOR EACH num IN arr DO
        complement <- target - num
        IF complement IN seen THEN
            ADD (MIN(num, complement), MAX(num, complement)) TO pairs
        END IF
        ADD num TO seen
    END FOR
    
    RETURN pairs
END FUNCTION
